STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_011911.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_011911.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_011911 (
    input clk_2f_c,
    input reset,
    input valid_in,
    input [31:0] Data_in,
    output reg valid_0_c,
    output reg [31:0] lane_0_c,
    output reg valid_1_c,
    output reg [31:0] lane_1_c
);
  reg contador;

  always @(*) begin
    if (reset == 0) begin
      valid_0_c <= 0;
      lane_0_c  <= 0;
      valid_1_c <= 0;
      lane_1_c  <= 0;
      contador  <= 0;
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk_2f_c) begin
    if (valid_in) begin
      case (contador)
        1'b0: begin
          contador  <= 1'b1;
          lane_0_c  <= Data_in;
          valid_0_c <= 1;
        end
        1'b1: begin
          contador  <= 1'b0;
          lane_1_c  <= Data_in;
          valid_1_c <= 1;
        end
      endcase
    end else begin
      valid_0_c <= 0;
      lane_0_c  <= 0;
      if (valid_0_c == 0) begin
        lane_1_c  <= 0;
        valid_1_c <= 0;
      end
    end
  end
endmodule
